notes: Eight web searches ran; none was refused. Search results for McClintock and AI were thin, so the search may be incomplete. The official-site search returned only an older floor speech opposing the Langevin Amendment to the NDAA (https://mcclintock.house.gov/newsroom/speeches/opposition-to-the-langevin-amendment-to-the-ndaa, not opened, undated in results and likely before 2025), which mentions the Commission on Artificial Intelligence only in the context of immigration and green cards; it would be level D at most and was left out. He is listed as a House Judiciary Committee member on the transcript of the 18 September 2025 subcommittee hearing 'AI at a Crossroads: A Nationwide Strategy or Californication?' (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CHRG-119hhrg61690/html/CHRG-119hhrg61690.htm, opened in two parts); he does not appear to have spoken there. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced by Rep. Casar on 24 September 2026): sources describe about nine or ten cosponsors, all Democrats; no source shows McClintock as a sponsor or cosponsor, but the full cosponsor list was not checked on Congress.gov. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Only the first page of his press releases (10 releases, 25 March to 19 September 2026) and the first page of his speeches (10 speeches, 8 April 2025 to 14 May 2026) were checked directly; none was about AI.
